# Metabo Drops Official Partner Site
> Metabo Drops is a dietary supplement — metabo drops — premium wellness product. This site is an authorized affiliate information resource and curates customer feedback from publicly available sources.
## About This Site
This is an authorized affiliate information and sales page for Metabo Drops. The reviews section aggregates customer feedback from public sources (product pages, independent review sites, social mentions). Individual customer statements are opinions, not medical claims, and have not been independently verified by this site. Statements on this site have not been evaluated by the FDA.
